solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Instrument's note beginning to fade away

indicators.note: the opening letter of the note's name disappears, as a sound fading at its start

parts.note: a sharp is a note raised by a semitone

explanation.surface: A musician describes how an instrument's note dies away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beginning to fade away' drops the S at the start of SHARP; the 's after 'Instrument' is 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A plucked stringed instrument with a large frame, so it is an example of an instrument.

clue.text: Fish seen in German water when river's risen

indicators.note: in a down entry, going up means the letter for river climbs to a higher position in the word

parts.note: Wasser is the German word for water
R is the standard abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A fish spotted in German waters as the river level rises.
explanation.walkthrough: In WASSER the R at the bottom climbs, in this down light, to second place: WRASSE.
explanation.definitionFit: A brightly coloured sea creature of rocky coasts, so it is a type of fish.

clue.text: Woman briefly working for Labour leader struggled

parts.note: Flo is the short form of the name Florence
someone who works for a boss is under them
Ed Miliband led the British Labour Party when this was published

explanation.surface: A woman who worked briefly for the Labour leader had a hard time.
explanation.walkthrough: Ed Miliband was Labour leader in 2011.
explanation.definitionFit: To flounder is to stumble about helplessly, which is a way of having struggled.

clue.text: Dances organised in tower

indicators.note: organised means put into a new arrangement, so the letters of the word dances are reordered

explanation.surface: Dances are arranged in a tower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tower' is the verb, as in to soar upward.
explanation.definitionFit: To tower is to rise high, a synonym for climbing upward.

clue.text: It's boring, not half, helping for a time

indicators.note: only the front portion of the word for boring is kept, the rest dropped

parts.note: something boring is dull
a ration is a helping or allotted portion

explanation.surface: Someone complains that a helping is boring, and not half, while eating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not half' keeps DU of DULL.
explanation.definitionFit: A length or period during which something lasts is a stretch of time.

clue.text: Notion that's less than perfect

indicators.note: the word for perfect falls short by its final letter

parts.note: ideal means perfect

explanation.surface: A notion that falls short of perfection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'less than' removes the last letter, L, from IDEAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A thought or concept formed in the mind; a synonym for notion.

clue.text: Language you get from one sailor with a vessel capsizing

indicators.note: a vessel capsizing turns over, so in this down light the whole string is turned upside down

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
tar is an old word for a sailor
a jug is a vessel for liquid

explanation.surface: A sailor picks up a language when his boat overturns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capsizing' turns ITARAJUG round to GUJARATI.
explanation.definitionFit: The tongue spoken in the Indian state of Gujarat, so it is a language.

clue.text: Saint, passionate old male within — one senses the brightness

indicators.note: within means the following pieces sit inside the saint's name

parts.note: St Peter is the obvious saint
hot means passionate

explanation.surface: A saint with a passionate old man inside him senses brightness.
explanation.definitionFit: An instrument for measuring light intensity, so it detects how bright something is.

clue.text: A particular organ's characteristic — loud initially

parts.note: an aura is a distinctive quality or air about something

indicators.note: initially takes only the opening letter of loud

explanation.surface: The distinguishing feature of a particular organ is its loudness.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'particular organ' is the ear; the surface suggests a church organ.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the ear, the specific organ of hearing, so it describes that organ.

clue.text: Spooner's endowment thus provides the bread

indicators.note: Dr Spooner swapped the starting sounds of words, so the two opening sounds trade places

parts.note: a dower is a widow's endowment from her husband's estate
so means thus

explanation.surface: Spooner's gift thus supplies the bread.
explanation.walkthrough: Spoken, DOWER SO becomes 'sour doe', which is spelt SOURDOUGH.
explanation.definitionFit: A loaf leavened with a fermented starter is a kind of bread.

clue.text: Virtuous — that's old saint in attitude

indicators.note: in places the old saint inside the word for virtuous

parts.note: pure means virtuous

explanation.surface: A virtuous person notes that an old saint had the right attitude.
explanation.definitionFit: A stance or bearing of body or mind is an attitude in both senses.

clue.text: Faith shown by worker in firm

parts.note: Adam Faith was a British pop singer and actor of the 1960s
a worker ant is the classic crossword worker

explanation.surface: Religious belief displayed by an employee in a company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Faith' looks like belief, but it is the singer Adam Faith; 'firm' is the adjective, not a company.
explanation.definitionFit: Unyielding and resolute, the same as standing firm on something.

clue.text: Make entreaty quietly to gain initiative

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quietly
to take the lead is to take the initiative

explanation.surface: Begging softly in order to win the initiative.
explanation.definitionFit: To beg or appeal earnestly is to make an entreaty.

clue.text: Plant in collection in container covering one small area

indicators.note: covering means the container wraps round the phrase in collection, holding it inside

parts.note: a pot is a container
taken as written
a set is a collection
I is the Roman numeral for one
A is the abbreviation for area

explanation.surface: A plant sits in a collection of pots, covering a small patch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' looks like a verb meaning to put in place, but it is the definition: the Christmas shrub.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mexican shrub with red leaf-like bracts, popular at Christmas, so a plant.

clue.text: Jersey's place for growing up in?

definitions.text: Jersey's place for growing up in?

parts.words: Jersey's place for growing up in?
parts.note: a Jersey is a breed of dairy cow, so the place it is raised is where milk is produced

explanation.surface: Where someone from the Channel Island of Jersey was brought up.
explanation.walkthrough: Jersey here is the cow, not the island or the jumper.
explanation.definitionFit: A Jersey calf grows up on a farm producing milk, the home of such cattle.

clue.text: Feeling great desire to be making pounds from one year to the next

indicators.note: from one year to the next spans the earning, so it sits between the two year letters
one year then the next gives the abbreviation twice

parts.note: making money is earning it
L (libra) is the abbreviation for pounds sterling

explanation.surface: Longing to earn money every year.
explanation.walkthrough: Two Ys enclose EARNING and L.
explanation.definitionFit: An adverb meaning in a longing manner, describing someone acting with strong desire.

clue.text: Player in support hugging fellows belonging to famous group

indicators.note: hugging means the support wraps round the fellows

parts.note: a strut is a structural support
men means fellows
the A-list is the group of top celebrities

explanation.surface: A musician in a support act embraces the members of a famous band.
explanation.definitionFit: A musician who plays an instrument is a player.

clue.text: Wall-to-wall task for cleaner

definitions.meaning: brushing the floor with a broom is a cleaner's job

explanation.surface: Wall-to-wall carpet is a job for the cleaner.
explanation.definitionFit: Means all-embracing as an adjective, and the act of using a broom as a noun.

clue.text: One for lunch maybe?

parts.note: lunch is an example of the category, a time when food is eaten

explanation.walkthrough: The definition is by example: lunch is one such occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: The time set for eating a meal, of which lunch is a typical case.

clue.text: Reliable female gets a good person after dodgy dates

indicators.note: after puts the female and the good person following the rearranged dates
dodgy means unsound or unreliable, so the letters of dates are reordered

parts.note: ST, for saint, is the crossword's good person

explanation.surface: A dependable woman finds a good man after some dubious dates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dodgy' rearranges DATES into STEAD.
explanation.definitionFit: Firm and unwavering, a synonym for dependable.

clue.text: Force hospital into health organisation?

indicators.note: into puts the hospital letter inside the organisation

parts.note: an NHS trust runs British health services

explanation.surface: Push a hospital into a health body.
explanation.walkthrough: An NHS trust is a body running UK National Health Service hospitals.
explanation.definitionFit: A thrust is a forceful push, a synonym for force.

clue.text: Country drink knocked back by monarch

indicators.note: by means next to, the monarch following the drink
knocked back, as of a drink downed, means the word is read backwards

parts.note: gin is a drink
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A country's drink downed by the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked back' turns GIN into NIG.
explanation.definitionFit: A West African state bordering Nigeria, so a country.

clue.text: Gets hold of files after end of meeting

indicators.note: after puts the files following the final letter
the end of meeting takes its final letter

parts.note: rasps are coarse files

explanation.surface: Someone takes possession of files when a meeting ends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'files' is a noun for tools here, not documents.
explanation.definitionFit: To grasp is to seize or grip something, so to get hold of it.

clue.text: Before publication script must be sort wanted by group

parts.note: a type is a sort or kind
a set is a group

explanation.surface: A script must be sorted as the group wants before it is published.
explanation.definitionFit: Text is composed in print-ready form before publication, so a script needs to be in that state.

clue.text: Half the riches lost? That's certain

indicators.note: with half the riches lost, only the back four letters of the word for riches remain

parts.note: treasure means riches

explanation.surface: Half the wealth gone? That's definite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half the riches lost' drops TREA, the front half of TREASURE.
explanation.definitionFit: Definite, beyond doubt, the same as certain.

clue.text: Managed, with bag, to obtain loot

parts.note: ran means managed, as in ran a business
a sack is a bag

explanation.surface: A thief succeeded, with a sack, in getting the plunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loot' is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To plunder or search a place thoroughly for spoils is to loot it.

clue.text: Youngsters? Fools!

definitions.meaning: deceives or teases someone, as a verb

explanation.definitionFit: A noun for children and a verb for teasing people with a jest.

clue.text: Amusing or silly person unlikely to win quiz?

indicators.note: silly means foolish or disordered, so the letters of amusing or are scrambled

explanation.surface: An amusing or foolish person who won't win a quiz.
explanation.definitionFit: An ignorant person lacks knowledge, so is a poor bet at a quiz.

clue.text: Fatty stuff I had — fleshy part at the front

indicators.note: at the front puts the fleshy part before the contraction

parts.note: a lip is a fleshy part of the mouth
I'd is the contraction of I had

explanation.surface: Fatty food I ate, with fleshy bits in front.
explanation.definitionFit: A fat or fat-like organic compound in living cells; fatty stuff.
